verdict.rationale: Railway documents horizontal scaling by adding replicas behind load balancing, and running apps closer to users. Nothing in the evidence addresses boot time or scale on the order of tens of thousands of instances, and replicas appear to be added manually rather than automatically under load. Missing for 10: sub-second boot/cold-start evidence, documented scale to tens of thousands of instances, automatic load-driven autoscaling, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can deploy instances that boot in under a second and scale to tens of thousands under load

citations.quote: Scale CPU and RAM or add replicas with load balancing.
Run your application closer to where your users are.
